handlers.description: No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns without changing game state.
No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns.
Repositions the player and named scene actors, resets NPC AI/head-control state, and removes or resets other scene objects. Scripted scene setup/cleanup; the exact scenario is unresolved.
Calls SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended(true) and clears a manager flag. Extends system inactivity-detection time.

Copies SavePlayer.ProfileMain.HandleName (the player's passport/profile title) into the speaking villager's SaveMemory or SaveLightMemory.HandleName and records HandleNameUpdateDate. The date uses the game's 05:00 day boundary.

Finds the existing UI object 0x87, cWherearenConstructionPortfolio, requests closure if it is active, and waits until its request/state fields are idle. This targets the vacation-home portfolio object directly; opening that object normally uses request 0x5C.
Requests UI operation 0x4A, mapped to object 0x61 (cCafeMenu), and waits for completion. This is the same target as EventFlowActionUICafeMenuAppearHandling.
Selects a fishing/insect tournament trophy by TrophyName (gold/silver/bronze), using item IDs 0x4B0 through 0x4B5, and stores it in shared event item storage.

Marks the villager treasure hunt as found by calling the completion/effect helper for the active player. The helper sets SaveLand.Npc.NpcVillager.Quest.Treasure.IsFind to 1. Query 0x871C6BB0 reads this same quest's deadline and step.
Requests UI operation 0x2C, mapped to object 0x0C (cSonkatsuResultMain), and waits for completion. Paired with quest-interface action 0x3C877539, which uses a different request and object.
Requests UI operation 0x5B, mapped to object 0x8A (cWherearenInspectUser), and waits for completion. This opens the vacation-home showcase user page, also targeted by UIWherearenInspectUserAppear.
Updates vacation-home/room state, including room-type value 0x24, using the same helper as the NPC-house expansion action. The exact transition is unresolved.
Requests UI operation 0x2B, mapped to object 0x0D (cSonkatsuQuestMain), and waits for completion. Related action 0x1B86AE7B opens cSonkatsuResultMain through request 0x2C.
Changes the quantity/stack encoding of the shared event item using AddNum. Rebuilds supported stackable items with an adjusted quantity; other cases substitute item 0x8A5.
No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns.

WaitFrame-based asynchronous wait. Resets/increments a counter; a nonnegative WaitFrame permits timed completion. Additional flow/UI flags can complete it early and mark the execution context. Those flags' meanings are unresolved.

Specialized public-announcement message action. Builds message IDs TalkSNpc/PublicAnnouncement/SP_PublicAnnouncement:102 or :103, then sequences further messages (including 103/104/105), using the standard dialogue controller. Exact conditions selecting each announcement are only partially interpreted.
Obtains the NPC's vacation-home identifier and invokes a home/room helper. Closely related to 0x95658963; the helper's exact effect is unresolved.
Writes the speaking NPC's villager index plus one to EmoticonLastLearnVillagerIndex. Records which villager most recently taught a reaction.

Reads the speaking villager's SaveAnimal.DIYRecipeIndex, checks that recipe's availability bit, and passes the recipe and player save slot to the recipe-grant helper. Related to EventFlowActionSetRecipeItem, which obtains its recipe through ItemUniqueID instead of the villager's current DIY recipe.
Starts manager task/state 1 when idle and waits until the manager becomes idle again. Task purpose unresolved.

Parses ThemeType using the parser shared with UIThemeAppear, then requests UI operation 0x46, mapped to object 0x6D (cTheme). Uses the same theme interface as UIThemeAppear; the original action name remains unresolved.

Configures an NPC movement target using Type and grid-relative OffsetX/OffsetZ, converts coordinates by a factor of 5, resets a control object, and replaces cached target state. Exact movement mode unresolved.
No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns.
Sets or clears bit 0x10000 in a player/control-manager flag word using Flag. The bit's gameplay meaning is unidentified.
Prepares a telop/notification request and selects the player using stage/session context. TelopKind is registered, but the exact notification mapping is unresolved.

Starts a Slot-specific cloud/network metadata operation, optionally refreshes data using WithRefresh, waits for task states, and records failure in flow context. Shares refresh code with NetCloudIslandGetMetaList.
Requests UI operation 0x27, mapped to object 0x4C (cStaffRoll), and waits for completion. This is distinct from cFesStaffCredit, opened by unknown action 0xBF150DAE.
Finds actor otg, assigns flow SNPC_otg_01_WherearenOffice and entry OrderStart, then requests AI state 0x51. Sets up the vacation-home office order conversation.
Asynchronous no-op: start does nothing, the next update marks completion, and cleanup does nothing.

Player dialogue action using the default message-window setup/update methods. Its custom message hooks return 1/0 without choosing a message string. The exact purpose of calling this default dialogue variant remains unresolved.
Calls SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended(false), complementing 0x09EC68C4, which passes true.
Selects the effective player and, if it matches the live/music manager's player, calls the routine used by TkkFreeAction with argument 1. Exact live-performance operation unresolved.
Sets FireworksApproachNpcIndex and FireworksApproachTalk and changes NPC AI/flow state. Prepares or records a fireworks approach conversation.

Selects shared event item/tag data using TagType, SetItemType, and ID. Branches include names, fruit, insects, fish, reward items, clothing, and equipment; a delivery branch reads SaveLand.Npc.NpcVillager.Quest.Delivery. Individual branches are identifiable, but the action's original name remains unresolved.
Scans 20/30/40 pocket slots according to UpgradePocket30/40 and removes items matching item 0xA12 or unique ID 0x515. Item names unresolved.
Obtains the NPC vacation-home identifier, invokes the helper used by 0x51FBBD8E, and stores room/home identifiers and a pending flag in shared vacation-home context.
Sets bit 0x08 in the shared vacation-home/event context flags word. Same visible state change as 0xA6A88A2E; flag meaning unresolved.
Sets bit 0x08 in the same shared context word as 0x994B59AF. Equivalent visible state change; flag meaning unresolved.
Retrieves the furniture actor from flow context and invokes a component's virtual operation with argument 0. Component/operation purpose unresolved.
Resolves vacation-home actors, positions an NPC, and changes AI state using helpers shared with ArrangeCharacterForOrder and SetupWherearenEndShareHouseDemoFromHouse. Exact scenario unresolved.

Gives the item stored at flow-context +0xBC to the active player using the normal item-insertion helper; requires a valid NPC actor. EventFlowActionSetDeliveryItemAtRandomColor writes its selected delivery item into that exact flow-context field.
Requests the money UI through the helper used by UIMoneyAppear and waits for associated UI state. Applies only to stages supporting the relevant UI capability.

Requests closure of the persistent cMiniGameStartFinish controller (the minigame start/finish overlay). WaitClose=false completes immediately; WaitClose=true waits for the controller's closed/completed flag. This uses the persistent controller rather than a factory object ID.
Restores stored player/NPC positions for a vacation-home scene and repositions actor mnc through helpers shared with ArrangeCharacterForOrder and MncWarpTakeOrderPos. Exact transition unresolved.
No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns.
Requests UI operation 0x5F, mapped to object 0x65 (cFesStaffCredit), and waits for completion. This festival staff-credit interface is distinct from the cStaffRoll object used by 0x788E3B23.

Builds an NPC delivery item from shared event item storage and adjusts supported stack quantities using Num; unsupported cases substitute item 0x8A5. Writes the NPC delivery record and flow-context +0xBC, the same destinations used by EventFlowActionSetDeliveryItemAtRandomColor. This action changes quantity without making that action's random variant selection.
Clears six ReserveCommune*OpenEvent flags and sets the one selected by a flow-context value. Selects the next commune shop/service opening event.
Toggles an NPC movement-control flag using MoveType: cMove enables it, cStop disables it. Exact controlled subsystem unresolved.
Writes SaveType into a save/network-manager request, forces state 2, and clears the previous task handle/result. Prepares an operation whose completion occurs outside this action.

Prepares a delivery/return item using ResumptionNum and the shared event item, updates NPC delivery storage, and passes the result to a player-item helper. Uses the delivery-item storage also written by EventFlowActionSetDeliveryItemAtRandomColor and the stack-count helpers shared with 0xC04FFA83 and 0x81CBE07B. Exact return/resumption scenario remains unresolved.
Enqueues a BGM/audio transition command under a mutex. Registers BGMProperty, StartVolume, EndVolume, FadeSec, FadeCurveType, DelaySec; command fields carry volume/fade/curve/delay values.
No-op stub: the synchronous execution method immediately returns.
Resolves an actor using CtPosTarget, queues a request on a component, and completes. Exact camera/control-target meaning and request type unresolved.

Builds randomized clothing/item candidates using SaveLand.NpcCamp, villager data, available pocket space, and the NmlNpcParam.Tops field. Paired with query 0x87849387, which checks eligibility using the same campsite data. The exact gift/clothing scenario remains unresolved.

Uses the current wandering visitor and cached hotel-room information to update the hotel stay/invitation state, then sets TodayWanderingNpcInvitePattern to 1. Shares the visitor lookup used by EventFlowQueryIsWanderingNpc and stay helpers with StayWanderingToHotelRoom. The original action name is unresolved.
Requests UI operation 0x09, mapped to object 0x4A (cKabuBuy), and waits for completion. This opens the turnip-purchase interface. Object ID 0x4A and request ID 0x4A select different screens.
Writes ItemUniqueId to the integer flow/entry variable named EntryVariableKeyint_ItemName, using the same setter as EntryVariableAdd and NpcEventItemSet.

Calculates safe vacation-home demo placements. Player/Customer/MncOtg/Housemate select actors and SafePostionType selects positioning behavior. Shares positioning helpers with SetupActorPosition and ArrangeCharacterForOrder.

Checks all five SavePlayerOther.PostingReserveList.ListCatalog entries. Returns 1 only when every reservation is populated and passes the date, item/message, and recipient validation; an empty/invalid entry returns 0. Missing player-save access returns 1. Same visible test as 0x782D7957.
Calls the hotel-room helper used by CheckHotelRoomCreated with a zero-initialized room descriptor and returns its inverted success bit. Exact intended room condition unresolved.
Normalizes environment date information, calls a player-context helper, and returns 1 on all visible paths. Does not currently distinguish outcomes.

Tests whether byte +0x54A in the BCAT-related manager is zero. Confirmed manager connection to SetBcatProcess and IsDoneBcatProcess; the known done query tests a different byte (+0x5B0). Exact flag meaning unresolved.

Inspects a cached selected NPC descriptor, resolves the NPC by name or actor list, and tests target absence/validity. Shares the NPC-name helper used by DeliveryItemIsFavor; exact UI condition unresolved.
Refreshes a UI cached field and returns whether context byte +0x12 is nonzero. This field also gates queries 0x2C880ECF, 0xB09C0418, and 0xEC63D82B; precise purpose unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.
Resolves the NPC vacation-home identifier and inverts the housemate/residency helper used by WherearenSetHousemate. Invalid actors return 1; exact predicate name unresolved.

Returns whether SavePlayerOther.NetMailBox.OfficialMailCountToday is at most 1. Returns 0 when the player-save slot is unavailable. This checks the daily official-mail count, rather than a general mailbox-empty condition.
Classifies a stored NPC code: bev -> 0, chm -> 1, slo -> 2, anything else -> 3. The context selecting this code remains unresolved.
Checks cached UI state and selected-item metadata, including item categories 0x0E and 0x13. Exact category labels and complete branch meanings unresolved.

Checks nine status bits in the NFC/controller subsystem and returns 1 only when all are clear. Takes controller/player selection into account. Shares manager pointers with NfcDisabled, ReadAmiibo, and CheckNfpController; individual bit meanings unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.
Resolves the villager's house/save slot using the helper shared with CancelNpcHouseEditReserve, then returns whether bit 0 in a house-edit record is clear. Missing/invalid records return 1.
Reads a player-held/selected item and returns whether its category differs from 0x0B. Invalid item/player cases return 1. Category name unresolved.

Checks whether the player lacks a required settler-quest inside material. SettlerType selects the settler; InsideMaterialType selects the item. Scans available pockets: matching item -> 0, absent/invalid -> 1.
Refreshes a cached UI record and returns whether its byte +0x17EC is zero. Exact UI field meaning unidentified.

Finds an eligible NPC-house item placement/candidate using item/layout/stage/save-bitset checks, stores an index, and marks the item processed. Selection -> 0, failure -> 1. This query has side effects.
Hashes the current hotel/visitor NPC name and uses the NPC database helper shared with DecideHotelAmiiboNpcVIP. Matching entry -> 0, absent -> 1. Exact lookup category unresolved.
Compares CheckDate (month*100+day) with month/day in cached UI date data: equal -> 0, different -> 1.
Reads the speaking NPC's InteriorCoordinator flag for the active player: nonzero -> 0, otherwise -> 1.

Classifies a context NPC/settler ID using three quest/residency lookup helpers. The first two successful lookups return 3; the third maps selected states through a table; default 4. Case labels unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 1. ToolSkillLevel is registered but unused by the visible query.
Reads the camera/control object used by KppBarcarolleControl and WherearenCompleteDemoCameraWait. Returns 1 when absent or bit 1 at +0x8C is clear. Exact camera condition unresolved.

Compares SavePlayer.PreviousLandId with the current SaveLand.LandId. Returns 0 for matching island identities and 1 for mismatch or unavailable data. When either saved island name is empty, the comparison falls back to the numeric ID. EventFlowQueryPlayerIsMovedIn reads the same PreviousLandId; SaveSwitchMovedOneToVillager writes it from the player's saved LandId.
Parses SeamlessStartTerms (cUnuse/cKeepFtrAndInNpcRoom0), checks vacation-home scene mode and room/stage IDs, and returns an inverted seamless-start eligibility condition.

Returns whether global outcome byte 0x7104F739F8 is zero. CheckAoCWithEnsureNSO explicitly clears this same byte when starting its add-on-content/network-service entitlement check. The later success/failure interpretation needs the state callbacks.
Returns whether bit 2 at +0x54 in the hotel/visitor manager is clear. Related to other queries reading this manager, including 0xB68FDF36; exact bit meaning unresolved.

Returns whether the dream-search manager result count (+0x200) is positive. NetIsFoundDreamLand reads this exact counter and tests count < 1 for its cLandName branch. This query tests the opposite condition.

Checks whether the current SaveLand.LandId occurs in the speaking normal villager's SaveAnimal.LastLandId history. Returns 0 for a match and 1 for no match or unsupported/missing actor/save data. The history comparison uses numeric IDs and, when available, the stored island names.
Runs a random test weighted by the villager's Friendship flag. Successful test -> 0; failed/unsupported -> 1. Exact probability formula is not assigned a gameplay interpretation here.

Compares the moved/visiting player's AccessKey event flag with Border. FlagCheckType modes 0..5 test !=, ==, <=, <, >=, >. Related to EventFlowActionEventFlagAllSharePlayPlayerAdd through player-flag access; this query selects the moved/visiting player, while that action updates eligible local group-play participants.
Resolves JudgeTarget using the target-item helper shared with HasCraftRecipeSelectFlow and IsFavoriteMusic, then tests whether that helper returns zero. Exact target-item predicate unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. DemeritPoint is registered but unused by the visible query.
Compares the speaking NPC identity against two names in vacation-home context: first match -> 0, second -> 1, otherwise -> 2. Exact roles of the two names unresolved.

Checks the Halloween calendar event, the speaking NPC's HasAcquaintanceship flag, inventory capacity, and SavePlayerOther.PostingReserveList before returning its exchange/conversation eligibility result. The saved-item subsystem is now identified as outgoing mail reservations; the full Halloween branch interpretation remains unresolved.

Uses the UI-selected player slot to read SaveLand.PlayerVillagerAccountTable.AccountTable[slot].AccountUid and compares this 128-bit account UID with the active account UID. Returns 0 for a match; invalid slot, empty UID, or mismatch returns 1. This compares account identity, not the villager's PlayerId.

Looks up the speaking NPC's saved cafe state in SavePlayerOther.MuseumCafeMemory.Unknown_83F31CB3. Stored values 0..4 map to -1..3; values 5 or greater map to 4; an invalid NPC index maps to -1. Missing/unsupported actor or save access returns 0. The cafe subsystem is identified, but the state labels remain unknown.

Checks all five SavePlayerOther.PostingReserveList.ListCatalog entries using the exact helper called by 0x051284AB. Returns 1 when all five are populated and valid, 0 if any entry is empty/invalid; missing player-save access returns 1.
Maps the stage ID to a house/facility lookup, checks it for the effective player, and returns inverted eligibility. Exact house/facility condition unresolved.
Uses UseShopType (PlayerSell/PlayerBuy) to select separate saved shop-use totals, then compares the selected total with Border. Exact counter names beyond buy/sell are unresolved.
For supported stackable shared event items, returns whether ResumptionNum minus current quantity is less than 1. Invalid/unsupported cases return 1.

Checks the treasure-hunt quest in SaveLand.Npc.NpcVillager.Quest.Treasure. When Base.Step is 2, returns whether Base.LimitTime minus current environment time is at most 60 seconds for nonzero Base.Kind, or 120 seconds for Kind 0. Other steps or unavailable land-save access return 1. This is a remaining-time/deadline test. Action 0x167FF457 marks this quest's IsFind field.

Tests clothing/item eligibility using SaveLand.NpcCamp, villager information, pocket capacity, and NmlNpcParam.Tops metadata. Closely parallels action 0xDDACF307. Sharing a random/weather manager with other named actions does not by itself identify the scenario.
Compares the NPC's current work animation/state name with WorkASName: match -> 0; mismatch/missing actor/component -> 1.

Resolves AccessKey and scans eligible local group-play participants: any nonzero matching player flag returns 0; otherwise returns 1. EventFlowActionEventFlagAllSharePlayPlayerAdd updates flags for this same participant-selection mechanism. This query tests group flags rather than adding to them.

Selects clothing data from SavePlayer.LookPack using ChangeStickInfo.IsUseCoordinate and LinkCoordinateIndex, with fallback outfit records, then checks whether the selected item's database entry is absent. Returns 1 for an absent/invalid item entry and 0 for a valid entry; missing player context/save access returns 0. The selected item slot within the outfit remains unresolved.
Uses the house-extension lookup shared with WherearenIsNpcHouseExtended and returns inverse bit 0 from its +0x153C field. Exact field meaning unresolved.
Returns whether hotel/visitor manager byte +0x08 is zero. Exact state meaning unidentified.

Returns whether the shared network-lock state differs from 2. NetLockFailReason reads the same state and maps state 2 to reason 1, state 5 to reason 2, and other states to 0. Precise user-facing reason labels remain unresolved.
Resolves cached UI-selected NPC/item data and tests item category 0xAC. Category and UI feature unidentified.

Classifies the four SaveLand.SnowManFamily.CreateSnowManList records using SnowManType and SnowManGrade, producing results 0..11. The save fields are identified; the individual result labels and grade/type enum names remain unresolved. Related to 0xB5C01106 and 0xC1B67CDD.
Reads ForceToolBreakDemo: nonzero -> 0; zero/missing actor context -> 1.
Inspects current furniture, requires furniture categories 10/11 and metadata, then checks metadata bits 0x18 against 0x10. Qualifying case -> 0, otherwise -> 1. Property label unresolved.
Resolves the selected hotel room using the helper shared with HotelRoomVisitSceneChange and tests whether its saved room flag is clear. Missing room/manager -> 1.
Selects the speaking NPC index or UISelectedNpcVillagerIndex and inverts a villager-save predicate. Exact condition unresolved.

Returns 1 when the player's Poki wallet or Poki savings is below its respective cap: wallet != 999999 OR savings != 999999999. Returns 0 only when both are at their caps. Shares the wallet-balance getter with EventFlowQueryHasPokiCount; this query tests combined wallet/savings capacity rather than an amount supplied by Money.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.
Normalizes the current game date at 05:00 and inverts an event-calendar predicate. Exact calendar condition unresolved.
Maps a UI-selected NPC through the helper shared with BptGetFriendship and compares the index with one of two player-context indices. Eligible match -> 0, otherwise -> 1. Exact UI roles unresolved.

Validates all five SavePlayerOther.PostingReserveList.ListMilage reservations, checking that each is populated, has an acceptable item, and has a valid date. Returns 1 only if all five pass; empty/invalid entries return 0. Missing player-save access returns 1. Related queries 0x051284AB and 0x782D7957 check ListCatalog instead.
Returns whether unreceived vacation-home salary is zero. Shares getter with WherearenUnreceivedPayTagSet and WherearenReceiveSalary.

Compares the island-rating scores in SaveLand.VillageScore: returns 1 when LifePoint <= NaturalPoint and 0 otherwise. These are the named rating-score fields, replacing the earlier unidentified float offsets.

Checks whether the four saved SnowManType values in SaveLand.SnowManFamily.CreateSnowManList collectively represent all four values 0..3. Returns 0 when all four are represented and 1 otherwise. This tests the saved snowman-type set; the original type enum labels remain unresolved.
Tests hotel-edit state and IsHotelEditTutorial. Returns 1 only when hotel edit is active, the tutorial flag is clear, and manager flag bit 0 is set; otherwise 0.
Returns whether manager counter +0xDF4C is less than Num. Counter's gameplay purpose unidentified.
Reads the effective player's PutFurnitureOutside event counter and returns whether it is below Threshold. Invalid player selection -> 1.
Parses FacilityType with the WherearenExistFacilityName parser, resolves a facility-front creation location, and tests whether its type differs from the requested facility or lookup fails.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.

Classifies SaveLand.SnowManFamily.CreateSnowManNum and the four CreateSnowManList[].SnowManType values into results 0..10. The source fields are identified; the individual result labels and type enum names remain unresolved. Related to 0xA01136BE and 0xB5C01106.

Selects one of two IDs in the clock/context manager according to session state and tests whether the ID is less than Id. The manager is also used by EventFlowQueryCheckNetworkTime, but the code compares an integer identifier rather than the network clock's calendar time. The identifier's meaning remains unresolved.

Reads UI-selected item's custom-design data and checks that its creator/owner identity is present in the design database. Qualifying case -> 0, otherwise -> 1. Shares design helpers with HghMydesignOwner and HghFreeAction.

Finds the player's acquaintance record for the speaking NPC and compares elapsed game days with Year*365 + Month*30 + Day: threshold met -> 0, otherwise -> 1. Parameters describe a duration, not an absolute date.
Normalizes shared vacation-home context +0x08: stored values 2..4 map to 1..3; missing/other values -> 0. Mode labels unresolved.
Tests vacation-home context state +0x14 against 4 and 5, with context-presence/flag gating. Eligible states 4/5 -> 0, otherwise -> 1. State labels unresolved.
Returns inverse low bit of vacation-home context +0x1A72. Missing context -> 1. Flag meaning unresolved.
Checks NPC birthdays against the game day; WithoutMoveNpc controls an additional moving-NPC exclusion. Shares lookup with TodayIsNpcBirthday. Complete result labels unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.

Returns selection/result state +0x27C from the vacation-home network manager, or 0 if that manager is absent. EventFlowQueryNetWherearenStructureType uses the same manager to classify the selected uploaded property. This connects the state to the vacation-home showcase/network selection flow, but its individual enum labels remain unresolved.
Resolves the UI-selected NPC and checks HasAcquaintanceship for the active player: flag == 1 -> 0; otherwise -> 1.

Returns SaveLand.SnowManFamily.IsCreateSnowMan directly; unavailable land-save access returns 0. This is the named snowman-creation flag. Separate queries classify CreateSnowManNum, SnowManType, and SnowManGrade.
Calls a player actor/control predicate: success -> 0, otherwise -> 1. Helper checks actor/component state; exact condition unidentified.
Calls the shared event item's ID accessor, discards the result, and returns 0. No conditional result is implemented.
Returns whether hotel/visitor manager state +0xA0 differs from 1. State enum meaning unresolved.
Constant-result stub: always returns 0. No condition is evaluated.
Tests a global NPC-related numeric code: above 300 or unsigned range 101..199 -> 1; otherwise -> 0. Semantic classification unresolved.

specialActions.name: EventFlowActionExitFlowchart
specialActions.behavior: Requests flowchart exit; handled directly by the dispatcher.

specialActions.name: EventFlowActionDummy
specialActions.behavior: Completes immediately; handled directly by the dispatcher.

unresolvedFlowNames.name: EventFlowActionReleaseVersionFile
unresolvedFlowNames.note: Declared by scripts, but no matching factory entry or special dispatcher implementation has been identified.
